title: Norwegian Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish originating from Norway, featuring lightly spiced lamb kebabs that are perfect for a quick dinner.

ingredients.name: Lamb cubes
ingredients.notes: preferably with a bit of fat for tenderness

ingredients.name: Norwegian-style kebab spice mix
ingredients.notes: available in most Scandinavian stores or online

instructions: 2. Thread lamb cubes, onion, bell pepper, and tomato onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
3. In a small bowl, mix together Norwegian-style kebab spice mix and olive oil.
4. Brush the spice mix mixture evenly onto both sides of the lamb cubes.
5. Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
6. Transfer the kebabs to a serving platter and garnish with parsley.
7. Serve immediately with lemon wedges on the side.
